items.text: A business analytics career after 40 is realistic when you build on domain experience, add SQL, spreadsheet and visualisation skills and show a project, because employers value people who understand the business and can explain results, even if age bias exists in some firms.
Use your domain knowledge as the advantage, learn the tools with free resources and build two projects in your own field.
Check outcomes and notices before paying.
